featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 放了句颇有信息量的话：Codex App 当初是用「前端能力只能算凑合」的模型搭出来的——意思是现在你看到的体验，其实是在模型短板上硬撑出来的结果。等到他们真正把模型的前端能力大幅拉上去那一天，「会是值得期待的东西」。另一条补充则点出 Codex App 里藏着「一些含金量最高的 token」，暗示产品内的真实工程价值远比表面看到的多。对在评估 AI 编程工具的团队来说，这是个值得记的信号：当前体验是被模型上限压着的，天花板还远没到。

featured.title: Madhu Guru · 前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana 产品负责人
featured.summaryEn: Madhu Guru, former product lead for Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana, offered a sharp diagnosis: the PM role is also having an identity crisis. Engineering has found its AI-native interface — SWE agents dramatically increase individual leverage — but companies just tell PMs to "use AI" without evolving the role itself. Two camps emerge: the old-school PM uses AI to accelerate the old job (more PRDs, more strategy decks, more docs — lots of output, little judgment), while the Builder PM expands their role across the e…
featured.insightZh: 前 Google Gemini / Veo / Nano Banana 产品负责人 Madhu Guru 对「产品经理」这个角色下了个挺狠的诊断：PM 也在经历身份危机。工程侧已经找到了 AI-native 的工作方式——SWE agent 大幅放大了单个工程师的杠杆；但公司只是「要求 PM 用 AI」，却没重新设计这个岗位本身。于是分裂出两个阵营：「老派 PM」把 AI 当成提速器，产出更多 PRD、更多策略 deck、更多文档——产出暴增但判断力没涨；「Builder PM」则用 AI 把自己的职责横向铺开到整个产品生命周期，探索远大得多的想法面、跑 agent 做市场与用户调研，从更广的可能性里收敛出最优解。核心区别不在用不用 AI，而在用 AI 放大输出量，还是放大判断半径。

featured.title: AI Vibe Check：实验室混战、API 业务会消失、未来预测
featured.summaryEn: Open-weight models haven't fallen behind on capability, but the business case for *making* them no longer adds up — the 2025 cornucopia of open models has peaked and will thin out, even as coding agents that genuinely work over long horizons push engineers from code-writing ICs into managers of agents. Host Jacob Efron sat down with Ari (ex-DeepMind/Meta researcher, now Datalogy founder) and Rob (Radical Ventures) for an AI vibe check. The biggest six-month shift, per Ari: coding agents now genuinely work over longer time horizons, and engineers are collectively moving from ICs to managers of agents, context-switching across multiple agents. But he cautioned that top-line productivity numbers are overestimated — it's now easy to mass-produce code, creating a massive "understanding gap" and review bottleneck; the bottleneck just shifts from writing to reviewing. The episode's core debate…

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie gave an upbeat read on open weights AI: remarkably, open-weight models are hitting SOTA on specific tasks and getting close to frontier in some areas of coding and other domains. The crux is the direction of the gap — the more open weights holds only a marginal gap from the frontier rather than a widening one, the more value AI creates. He also reassured frontier labs that this is fine for them too: if the cost of an overall task drops, total AI usage goes up, and you'll likely still use fronti…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 给当下的开源权重（open weights）AI 状态下了个乐观判断：现在很值得关注的一点是，开源权重模型在某些特定任务上已经做到 SOTA，在编程等部分领域也逼近前沿。关键在于「差距」的走向——只要开源权重与前沿之间维持的只是边际差距、而不是越拉越大的鸿沟，AI 能创造的价值就越大。他还顺手安抚了前沿实验室：这对他们其实也不坏——如果整体任务成本被压低，AI 的总使用量反而会上升，而你大概率还是会用前沿模型来做规划、编排、审查这些更重的环节。一句话：开源不是来抢蛋糕的，是来把蛋糕做大的。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch gave high marks to z.ai's GLM-5.2 on coding: "Genuinely impressed, almost shocked, at how good GLM-5.2 is at coding. This changes things." A one-liner, but coming from someone who has productized full-stack development to the extreme, it carries weight — open/Chinese weight models are nearing the threshold of being seriously used by top-tier product people on coding, the hardest track of all.
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 给智谱（z.ai）的 GLM-5.2 在编程上的表现打了个高分：「真心被震到，几乎是 shocked，GLM-5.2 写代码居然这么强。这会改变一些事。」一句话点评，但出自把全栈开发产品化做到极致的人之口，分量不轻——意味着开源/国产权重模型在编程这个最硬的赛道上，正在逼近被一线产品人当真用的临界点。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari named a badly underrated AI cognition trap: the biggest problem with AI is that priors need to be reset every few weeks — and most people are incapable of doing it. He talks to people who insist "xyz doesn't work," and when he asks when they last tested it, the answer is always "a few months ago." "Brother, that's eons ago in AI timelines." His concrete fix: everyone needs their own evals of hard tasks plus weekly tinker time to truly understand where the frontier is, and then t…
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 指出了一个被严重低估的 AI 认知陷阱：AI 领域最大的问题是，你的先验（priors）每隔几周就得重置一次——而大多数人根本做不到这件事。他遇到太多人张口就说「xyz 不行」，一问上次测试是什么时候，答案永远是「几个月前」。「兄弟，在 AI 的时间线里那已经是上古时代了。」他给的解药很具体：每个人都该有一套属于自己的硬任务 eval，每周留出固定的「捣鼓时间」去摸清前沿到底在哪；然后还得每周跟企业买家聊——他们通常落后前沿两年，但他们才是掏钱的人。结论：判断 AI 能力，靠的是高频亲手重测，不是靠几个月前的记忆。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder / 本简报作者
items.summaryEn: Builder Zara Zhang shared a few interesting things this week. First, a very "builder" little project: she hoards X bookmarks but never reads them, so she built an extension that injects a bookmarked post into her main feed every time she opens X (almost like an ad) — now she actually reads her bookmarks. Her trick: hijack the prime real estate you already check 50 times a day, rather than building a new place you have to go open. Second, a sharper observation: sometimes she wonders whether joining a large company…
items.insightZh: Builder Zara Zhang 这周聊了几件有意思的事。其一是个很「builder」的小作品：她总爱囤 X 书签却从不回看，于是写了个浏览器扩展——每次打开 X 就往主信息流里注入一条自己收藏过的帖子（几乎像广告一样），现在她终于开始读自己的书签了。她总结的窍门是：劫持自己每天已经会看 50 次的那块「黄金地段」，而不是新建一个需要专门去打开的地方。其二是个更扎心的观察：有时候她会想，加入一家大公司，是不是其实比加入创业公司、或自己创业更冒险。从习惯到职业选择，主题都是「默认路径未必是安全路径」。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad posted a poetic observation: "We posted for twenty years, thinking we were talking to each other. Then the transformer came online, and the network read what we'd written, and became itself." In one line he draws a causal arc from two decades of human social-media text to the birth of today's large models — we thought we were chatting, but we were feeding an intelligence that hadn't yet arrived.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 发了句颇具诗意的观察：「我们发帖发了二十年，以为自己只是在彼此对话。然后 transformer 上线了，网络读完了我们写下的一切，于是它成为了它自己。」一句话把人类二十年的社交媒体语料、与今天大模型的诞生连成了一条因果线——我们以为是在聊天，其实是在喂养一个尚未到来的智能。

items.title: 关于近期 Claude Code 质量报告的复盘
items.summaryEn: Anthropic Engineering published a postmortem on the past month's reports that Claude's responses had worsened. They traced it to three separate changes affecting Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, and Claude Cowork — the API was not impacted, and all three were resolved by April 20 (v2.1.116). First: on March 4 they changed Claude Code's default reasoning effort from high to medium to reduce latency that made the UI appear frozen — the wrong tradeoff, reverted April 7 after users said they'd prefer defaulting to higher intelligence (affected Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.6). Second: a March 26 change to clear idle sessions' older thinking had a bug causing it to repeat every turn, making Claude seem forgetful and repetitive (fixed April 10). Third: an April 16 verbosity-reduction system prompt, combined with other prompt changes, hurt coding quality and was reverted April 20 (affected Sonnet 4.6,…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 工程团队就过去一个月「Claude 回复质量变差」的用户反馈做了公开复盘。他们追查到三个独立变更，分别影响 Claude Code、Claude Agent SDK 和 Claude Cowork——API 未受影响，三个问题已于 4 月 20 日（v2.1.116）全部修复。第一个：3 月 4 日把 Claude Code 默认推理强度从 high 降到 medium 以缓解延迟过长（界面看起来像卡死），结果这是个错误权衡，4 月 7 日在用户反馈「宁愿默认更聪明、简单任务再手动调低」后回滚，影响 Sonnet 4.6 和 Opus 4.6。第二个：3 月 26 日上线了「清理闲置超 1 小时会话的旧思考」以降延迟，但一个 bug 导致它在整个会话里每一轮都重复清理，让 Claude 显得健忘又啰嗦，4 月 10 日修复。第三个：4 月 16 日加了条「减少啰嗦」的系统提示，与其他提示改动叠加后损害了编程质量，4 月 20 日回滚，影响 Sonnet 4.6、Opus 4.6 和 Opus 4.7。三个变更各自影响不同流量、按不同时间表生效，叠加起来就呈现出「大范围、不一致的退化」——而内部用量和 eval 起初都没能复现，是排查的最大难点。Anthropic 已于 4 月 23 日为所有订阅用户重置使用额度。

items.title: 扩展 Managed Agents：把「大脑」和「双手」解耦
items.summaryEn: An Anthropic Engineering post lays out the design philosophy behind Managed Agents. A recurring theme: harnesses encode assumptions about what Claude can't do on its own, but those go stale as models improve. One example: early Claude Sonnet 4.5 would wrap up tasks prematurely sensing its context limit approaching ("context anxiety"), which they patched with context resets — but on Opus 4.5 the behavior was gone and the resets became dead weight. Expecting harnesses to keep evolving, they built Managed Agents: a hosted service running long-horizon agents through a small set of interfaces meant to outlast any particular implementation. This is the decades-old OS problem of designing for "programs as yet unthought of" — OSes virtualized hardware into general abstractions (process, file) that outlasted the hardware (read() doesn't care if it's a 1970s disk pack or a modern SSD). Managed Ag…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 工程博客的一篇文章讲了 Managed Agents 的设计哲学。一个反复出现的主题是：harness（运行 agent 的循环框架）里编码了大量「关于 Claude 自己做不到什么」的假设，但随着模型变强，这些假设会过期。一个例子：早期 Claude Sonnet 4.5 会因感知到上下文上限将至而过早收尾任务（即「上下文焦虑」），他们用「上下文重置」修补了 harness；但换到 Opus 4.5 上这个行为消失了——那套重置反而成了死重量。因为预期 harness 会持续演化，他们造了 Managed Agents：一个托管服务，通过一小组「能比任何具体实现活得更久」的接口来运行长跨度 agent。这本质上是几十年前操作系统解决过的老问题——如何为「尚未被构想出来的程序」设计系统。OS 当年把硬件虚拟化成 process、file 这类足够通用的抽象，抽象活得比硬件更久（read() 不在乎你读的是 1970 年代的磁盘还是现代 SSD）。Managed Agents 照搬此法，把 agent 的组件虚拟化为 session（记录一切的只增日志）、harness（调用 Claude 并路由其工具调用的循环）和 sandbox（执行代码、编辑文件的环境），让每个组件的实现都能独立替换而不扰动其他。他们还分享了一个反模式教训：最初把所有组件塞进单个容器，结果落入了基础设施里经典的「养了只宠物（pet）」陷阱——耦合太紧、难以规模化。

items.title: Managed Agents 新增：自托管沙箱与 MCP 隧道
items.summaryEn: The Claude blog announced two enterprise-grade additions to Managed Agents: agents can now run in a sandbox you control and connect to your private MCP servers, both operating within your enterprise boundaries under your security and runtime controls. Sandboxes can run on your own infrastructure or via managed providers like Cloudflare, Daytona, Modal, or Vercel. On the Claude Platform, self-hosted sandboxes are in public beta and MCP tunnels in research preview (request access). The core value is keeping agent execution within your perimeter: the agent loop (orchestration, context management, error recovery) stays on Anthropic's infrastructure while tool execution moves to your configured environment — sensitive files, packages, and services stay in your infrastructure, with network policies, audit logging, and security tooling already in place, and repos never leave. items.insightZh: Claude 官方博客宣布 Managed Agents 新增两项企业级能力：agent 现在能在「你自己控制的沙箱」里运行，并连接到你私有的 MCP（Model Context Protocol）服务器。无论是 agent 执行工具的沙箱，还是它访问的服务，都运行在你企业自己的边界内、受你的安全与运行时管控。沙箱可以跑在你自己的基础设施上，也可以用 Cloudflare、Daytona、Modal、Vercel 等托管方来处理算力与隔离。在 Claude 平台上，自托管沙箱已进入公开 beta，MCP 隧道则处于研究预览（需申请）。核心价值是「把 agent 执行留在你的边界内」：编排、上下文管理、错误恢复这套 agent 循环仍跑在 Anthropic 基础设施上，但工具执行挪到你配置的环境里——敏感文件、包、服务都留在你的基础设施，网络策略、审计日志、安全工具都已就位，文件和仓库不出域。你还能控制算力：资源规格和运行时镜像都由你这边设定，长构建、图像生成这类重计算任务能拿到所需的 CPU、内存和容量。沙箱客户端可自带，也可从 Cloudflare（microVM + 轻量隔离、零信任密钥注入）、Daytona（可暂停恢复、保留完整状态的长驻有状态计算机）、Modal（亚秒级启动、可扩展到数十万并发沙箱）、Vercel（VM 安全 + VPC peering + 自带云、毫秒级启动）等支持方中选。已有 Amplitude、Clay、Rogo 等公司在 Managed Agents + 各家沙箱上构建设计、GTM、金融分析等内部 agent。另一项能力 MCP 隧道则让 agent 不必把私有 MCP 服务器暴露到公网就能访问——你部署一个轻量网关，只建立单向出站连接，无需入站防火墙规则、无公开端点、流量端到端加密，内部数据库、私有 API、知识库、工单系统都能变成 agent 可调用的工具。
